name: Bilbao
tagline: Postwar pintxos, txangurro like always, and a Michelin star inside the Guggenheim.

Víctor Montes.description: Started as a grocery store in 1849 and is today the emblem of pintxos in Plaza Nueva, in the Old Town.

A Mina.description: Product-driven cuisine from chef Álvaro Garrido by the estuary, on Paseo de Marzana. One Michelin star.

Zarate.description: A temple of grilled fish and seasonal shellfish. One Michelin star.

Nerua Guggenheim Bilbao.description: Contemporary Basque haute cuisine inside the Guggenheim Museum itself. One Michelin star.

El Globo.description: Its gratinated txangurro pintxo is an absolute classic, next to the Provincial Council Palace.
